common.soon: This screen arrives in the next step.

onboarding.hello: Hi, I’m Owli. I help you eat for your goal without counting by hand. What should I call you?
onboarding.nameOptional: Optional. You can leave it blank.

titles.body: Tell me about you. This is how I work out what you burn each day.
titles.bodyNamed: {{name}}, tell me about you. This is how I work out what you burn each day.
titles.goal: What are you after? I’ll tell you how much to eat and by when, no wild promises.
titles.diet: How do you eat? Every suggestion will respect your diet.

very_active.long: Very active: physical job or two sessions

onboarding.burnPending: Pick your biological sex and I’ll work it out.

errors.sexRequired: Pick one: the daily energy formula needs it.
errors.underage: Owli is for people 18 and over.
errors.wrongDirectionCut: To lose fat, your goal weight needs to be below your current weight.
errors.wrongDirectionBulk: To build muscle, your goal weight needs to be above your current weight.

onboarding.etaHonest: It’s an estimate: bodies don’t change in a straight line.
onboarding.etaTooSlow: At your current energy use, the safe minimum leaves very little room. Adding activity will help more than eating less.
onboarding.lowBmi: That weight is below the healthy range for your height.
onboarding.clamped: I won’t go below {{min}} kcal: that’s the safe minimum.
onboarding.provisional: The goal adjustment is provisional and still needs review by a professional.

paleo.label: Paleo
paleo.hint: No grains, legumes, dairy or sugar

voice.vegetarian: Noted. Eggs and dairy will be your allies.
voice.pescetarian: Noted. The sea will be your big protein source.
voice.vegan: Noted. We’ll hit your protein with plants only.
voice.keto: Perfect. I’ll watch every gram of carbs for you.
voice.paleo: Noted. Real food, the old way.

onboarding.ready: All set. You can start your day.
onboarding.readyNamed: All set, {{name}}. You can start your day.
onboarding.gift: Your first 15 AI analyses are on us. Logging by hand is always free.
onboarding.later: The rest (meals per day, reminders, Apple Health) I’ll ask when it matters.
onboarding.mealsLabel: How many meals do you eat a day?
onboarding.mealsHint: Owli splits what's left across your remaining meals. You can change it in your account.

errors.offline: No connection. Check your internet and try again.
errors.unknown: Something went wrong loading your day.

empty.title: Nothing logged yet today
empty.body: Log your first meal and I’ll tell you what’s left.

conflict.gluten_free: Contains gluten. You can still log it; Owli won’t suggest it.
conflict.lactose_free: Contains lactose. You can still log it; Owli won’t suggest it.

offDiet.carnivore: Not animal-based: outside the carnivore diet.
offDiet.vegetarian: Has meat or fish: outside the vegetarian diet.
offDiet.pescetarian: Has meat: outside the pescatarian diet.
offDiet.paleo: Outside the paleo diet (grain, legume, dairy or sugar).

mood.satisfied: Day closed: calories and protein on target.

hint.over: Tomorrow balances it out: one day doesn’t define anything.

photo.errorBody: No credit was used. Check your connection and try again.
photo.noFoodTitle: We didn’t see food in the photo
photo.noFoodBody: No credit was used. Try another photo with the plate in clear view.
photo.noCreditsBody: You get another one tomorrow. Meanwhile, logging by hand is always free.
photo.reviewHint: Adjust the grams if something looks off: the photo is an estimate.
photo.notFound: Not in our database yet: pick a similar one or remove it.
photo.check: Check this one: I’m not sure.
photo.leftAfter: If you save it, {{kcal}} kcal left.
photo.overAfter: If you save it, you go {{kcal}} kcal over.
photo.unresolved: {{n}} without a food chosen: it won’t be saved.
photo.discarded: The photo isn’t stored: it’s discarded after the analysis.

voice.recordingHint: Tell me what you ate and how much. For example: "two beef empanadas and a salad".
voice.noFoodBody: No credit was used. Try again, naming each food and the amount.
voice.reviewHint: Adjust the grams if something looks off: it's an estimate from what you said.
voice.discarded: The audio isn't stored: it's discarded after the analysis.
voice.micErrorBody: Allow it in your browser or phone permissions. Meanwhile, you can log by hand or take a photo.

closing.need: You need {{kcal}} kcal, {{p}} g of protein, {{c}} g of carbs and {{f}} g of fat.
closing.needNet: You need {{kcal}} kcal, {{p}} g of protein, {{c}} g of net carbs and {{f}} g of fat.
closing.split: That's what's left today, split across your {{n}} remaining meals.
closing.lastNote: It's your last meal of the day: it covers everything left.
closing.overFat: You're {{g}} g over on fat today: these dishes add almost none.
closing.overCarbs: You're {{g}} g over on carbs today: these dishes add almost none.
closing.sidesHint: Protein is almost covered: here is something to add what is left.
closing.free: Everything fits your diet. Logging a dish is free.
closing.closedBody: You reached today's calories. Tomorrow we start fresh.
closing.noneTitle: I couldn't find dishes that fit
closing.noneBody: With what you need and your diet, no dish on the list works. You can log what you eat by hand.
closing.error: We couldn't load the suggestions. Check your connection.
closing.logError: The dish couldn't be logged. Try again: what was already logged won't repeat.

week.title: Your week
week.error: We couldn't load your week. Check your connection.
week.emptyBody: Log your meals and you'll see how each day went here.

comment.proteinOne: Protein fell short one day: prioritize it at lunch.
comment.proteinOther: Protein fell short {{n}} days: prioritize it at lunch.
comment.overOne: You went over your calories one day. One day defines nothing.
comment.overOther: You went over your calories {{n}} days. Check which meal ran long.
comment.allClosed: Every day you logged stayed on target.
comment.keepGoing: You're doing well: log every meal to close more days.

week.streak: You've logged {{n}} days in a row.
week.detail: {{kcal}} kcal ({{dk}}) and {{p}} g of protein ({{dp}} g).
week.note: Averages use finished days with entries. Every day is compared with your current target.

account.title: Your account
account.macros: Protein {{p}} g, carbs {{c}} g, fat {{f}} g

mealsHint.1: One meal a day (OMAD): Owli suggests covering everything at once.
mealsHint.2: Two meals, for example lunch and dinner.
mealsHint.3: Three meals: breakfast, lunch and dinner.
mealsHint.4: Four meals: breakfast, lunch, an afternoon snack and dinner.
mealsHint.5: Five meals: the usual four plus a snack.

account.mealsWhy: Owli splits what's left of your day across the meals you have left. If you do intermittent fasting, pick fewer meals.
account.fixErrors: Fix what is marked to save.

saved.pending: Saved on this phone. It will sync to your account when you are back online.

account.creditsHow: Each analyzed photo or recording uses 1. Today's free ones go first, then welcome ones, then purchased ones. Logging by hand is always free.
account.proSoon: Owli Pro and analysis packs are coming soon.
account.anonymous: Your account is anonymous and tied to this phone. Soon you'll be able to link it to Apple or Google so you don't lose your data if you switch phones.
account.deleteBody: Your profile, meals and remaining analyses are deleted, on this phone and on the server. This cannot be undone.
account.deleteFailed: We couldn't delete your account: check your connection and try again. For now it's intact.
account.disclaimer: Owli is not a substitute for medical or nutritional advice. If you have a health condition, talk to a professional before changing how you eat.
